RECOMMENDED Designed for goalkeepers competing at a professional or semi-professional level who want the perfect balance between technical innovation and comfort. Ideal for intense training, high-level competition or demanding weather.

With a commanding design and advanced technologies, the Zeus 2.0 combines lightness, grip and comfort like never before. Built with an Airflex Pro body, it offers superior mobility, elasticity and breathability. Its Vapor Negative cut, an evolution of the traditional one, provides a perfect fit and boosts total ball control. It is the ultimate choice for keepers who own every save with confidence and class The Zeus UGT+ II stands out for its exclusive, innovative system of silicone inserts injected into the backhand, designed to deliver unmatched grip and fit. With an innovative approach and a perfect fit, the Zeus is the star glove of our collection and the best-selling model in our glove line. GLOVE PALM The Zeus 2.0 UGT+ II palm features 4 mm UGT+ II latex, a new 100% natural German latex formula that combines maximum grip with exceptional durability. Made with high-performance German latex , it offers exceptional grip even in wet or adverse conditions. Multi-layer foam technology provides effective impact absorption, ideal for high-power catches. GLOVE CUT The exclusive Vapor Negative cut is an evolution of the traditional Negative cut, finished with the seams on the inside. It gives an ultra-snug fit around the contour of the fingers, maximizing ball control and reducing the space inside the glove. This cut is ideal for technical goalkeepers, as it gives a precise, natural feel on contact. GLOVE BACKHAND The body is made of Airflex Pro , a latest-generation technical fabric that stands out for its elasticity, breathability and lightness . This structure allows efficient ventilation to reduce heat build-up during play, keeping hands dry and agile throughout the action. GLOVE WRIST AND CLOSURE The one-piece tubular wrist, an extension of the backhand, makes the glove easy to put on and take off without losing a firm fit. The 360º closure , with a double elastic strap and two velcro points, tightens over the backhand without interfering with the extended palm: a firm, secure fit that keeps the glove in place throughout the match without restricting wrist mobility. RECOMMENDED Designed for goalkeepers competing at a professional or semi-professional level who want the perfect balance between technical innovation and comfort. Ideal for intense training, high-level competition or demanding weather.
